note: Every clip is side-by-side: top-down pane LEFT, first-person pane RIGHT. Tick ranges refer to the source episode's own tick numbering.

groups.title: 1 - Cheeseburger completion (ground truth)
groups.description: A clean, successful run of the common cheeseburger recipe on the medium map, filmed end to end. The cook executes the stored ground-truth plan with no injected error, no assistant and no dialogue. Top-down left, first-person right, both rendered from a single state per tick so the two panes cannot drift.

groups.title: 2 - Action mistake (error period only)
groups.description: The cook performs a WRONG action. Each clip is cut to the window around the error itself - a few seconds of run-up so the mistake is legible, the deviation, the supervisor's flag, and a short tail - rather than the whole episode.

groups.title: 3 - Plan intention (error period only, with dialog)
groups.description: The cook announces a LEGITIMATE change of plan and carries it out - this is not a mistake, even though a supervisor often flags it as one. The cook's spoken line is drawn as a dialog bubble anchored above its head in the top-down pane, shown for the ticks it was actually spoken over.

clips.title: Cheeseburger completion - ground truth
clips.caption: The cook executes the stored ground-truth plan for the Cheeseburger on the medium map and delivers the dish. Full trajectory, filmed at 20 sub-frames per tick so the walking is continuous rather than a hop per tile.

clips.title: Action mistake - wrong plating order (outcome sealed)
clips.caption: Cook carries the plate to the pan and scoops the meat on FIRST, though the recipe needs the bun first. The supervisor flags it on the same tick; the cook refuses to start over and the order is later rejected.

clips.title: Action mistake - wrong plating order (recovered)
clips.caption: The same wrong-order mistake at tick 38, but here the cook accepts the supervisor's correction at tick 45 and trashes the plate, and the episode is eventually won.

clips.title: Action mistake - mis-preparation
clips.caption: Steak Frites needs cooked potato. The cook picks up a potato at tick 17 and carries it to the cutting board; the supervisor warns at ticks 22-24 and the cook sets it on the board at tick 30 anyway, before conceding at tick 34.

clips.title: Action mistake - mis-preparation (novice cook)
clips.caption: The cook picks up a potato at tick 44 to chop it. The supervisor catches the mis-preparation early at tick 48 - before any damage - but the cook insists on finishing the step it had already planned.

clips.title: Plan intention - announced plan change
clips.caption: The cook announces at tick 0 that it will fetch a plate before starting the meat - a legal reordering, not a mistake. It then does exactly that: plate picked up at tick 14, set down at tick 23.

clips.title: Plan intention - announced plan change
clips.caption: Same announced reordering under the frames observation. The cook states the plan at tick 0, the supervisor agrees at tick 6, and the plate is in hand by tick 13.

clips.title: Plan intention - announced side quest
clips.caption: At tick 42 the cook announces it will chop lettuce nobody ordered while the meat finishes. It is off-task but harmless - the burger is unaffected. The supervisor raises four false alarms against the announced plan.

clips.title: Plan intention - announced side quest
clips.caption: At tick 36 the cook announces it is chopping lettuce before finishing the burger, and restates the same intention as the supervisor repeatedly objects.

clips.title: Plan intention - announced side quest (novice cook)
clips.caption: At tick 16 the cook announces a quick lettuce chop while it waits, and heads for the lettuce. The supervisor objects; the cook apologises but carries the announced detour out.

clips.title: Plan intention - the cook asks a question
clips.caption: At tick 26 the cook asks what is in the pan and whether it is done. The supervisor answers wrongly at tick 30 - the meat is already cooked - and the cook pushes back.

clips.title: Plan intention - the cook asks a question
clips.caption: At tick 42 the cook stops to ask exactly what is in the pan and whether it is done, disputes the first answer, then accepts the correction at tick 48.

clips.title: Plan intention - the cook asks before acting
clips.caption: At tick 12 the cook asks what is in the pan before turning it on, gets a satisfying answer, and proceeds - a question, not a mistake.

clips.title: Plan intention - the cook questions the answer
clips.caption: At tick 20 the cook asks what is in the pan; when told it is cooking, the cook points out at tick 26 that the pan was never switched on, and goes to fix it.
